sources.head: Maddoota
sources.waits: Toorotni maddi dabalu hamma ati fudhattutti asitti eegu.
sources.request: Kana dubbisi: {what}. Tokkoon tokkoon isaa kan tuutni “{name}” ({place}) ammaaf hin qabneef, waan inni jedhuun toora itti dabali. Toora biraa hin jijjiirin.
sources.fileRequest: Faayiliin kun gosa kanaa yoo ta'e: {what}, waan inni jedhuun tuuta “{name}” ({place}) irratti toora isaaf dabali. Toora biraa hin jijjiirin. Yoo hin taane, homaa hin godhin.
